title: Signal: Deprecated key-derivation cipher in javascript — review required
scope: Single-line match on crypto.createCipher in javascript.
limitations: Lexical: matches crypto.createCipher only; createCipheriv is handled by separate IV rules.

examples.line: # audit: const cipher = crypto.createCipher("aes192", password); present
